data.title: Church & Dwight to Present at the 2026 Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference
data.description: In Ewing, New Jersey, Church & Dwight Co., Inc. (NYSE: CHD) is scheduled to participate in the 2026 Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference on September 9, 2026, at 2:15 PM EDT. Established in 1846, Church & Dwight is a prominent U.S. manufacturer of sodium bicarbonate, commonly referred to as baking soda. The company offers an extensive selection of personal care and household products. To access the broadcast, a link will be available on Church & Dwight’s website in the Investors section.
